title: Why Nvidia, Delta, and TSMC All Need Chroma: An Exclusive Interview with CEO I-Shih Tseng
gist: A teaser for an interview with Chroma CEO I-Shih Tseng, claiming Nvidia, Delta Electronics and TSMC rely on Chroma for GPU system-level test, power testing and advanced-packaging metrology. As AI chips get costlier and more complex, testing is framed as a launch-gating necessity rather than a yield tool.
